text:
sam (release-manager): quick check — finalizing release notes and internal blast for tomorrow's rollout. timing window 02:00-04:00 UTC. can owners confirm pin and rollback criteria?

alex (eng): pin v2.14.3 to prod images. we should keep v2.13.x as fallback with traffic shift script ready.

tara (pm): copy for internal annc below — short, 2 bullets. jules pls review microcopy.
jules (docs): on it. draft: "Tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC we will deploy model-serving v2.14.3. Expect brief 1–2m latency spikes; use fallback flag if errors exceed 5% over 5m. See runbook link: https://intranet/runbooks/release-2026-03"

mike (oncall): rollback trigger: 1) 5% error rate sustained for 10m OR 2) 50% increase in p50 latency for 15m. if triggered, we immediately pin back to v2.13.9 and notify #incidents. I'll be on pager.

sam (release-manager): agreed. add a canary step: 10% traffic for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then full. deploybot, queue the rollout with canary ladder.

deploybot: Deploy job created by @sam: deploy/prod/v2.14.3 — canary 10% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. ID: job-2026-49432. Logs: start when triggered.

alex (eng): deploy command for ops if we need manual trigger/rollback:
```
# apply pin and kick canary
rdctl deploy --env=prod --image=redwood/serve:v2.14.3 --canary=10,15m:50,10m:100
# rollback to pinned fallback
rdctl rollback --env=prod --target-image=redwood/serve:v2.13.9
```

jules (docs): internal announce subject suggestion: "Prod deploy: model-serving v2.14.3 — 02:00 UTC maintenance window". Keep body short w/ link to runbook & who to ping.

tara (pm): also include short 'what's changing' bullets: 
- improved kv-cache eviction to reduce cold starts
- quantization patch for RoPE stability

sam (release-manager): action items: alex -> confirm deploy job readiness + smoke tests by EOD; jules -> final internal gist and Slack snippet by 22:00 UTC; mike -> ensure pager pair; tara -> approve copy. I'll hold final go at 23:30 UTC.

mike (oncall): pager pair confirmed: me + rachel (oncall-eu). I'll add emergency channel on the job.

alex (eng): smoke tests green locally. I pushed a quick rollback script to infra repo and set shas.

jules (docs): posting internal snippet — please thumbs up if OK: 
"Heads up — deploying model-serving v2.14.3 tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Expect <5m of disruption at canary ramp; triggers and rollback criteria noted. Contact @mike (oncall) for incidents. Full details: https://intranet/runbooks/release-2026-03"

sam (release-manager): :thumbsup: locking this as final. I'll hit deploybot at 02:00 UTC, starting canary. If anyone wants to add to the release notes (public changelog) file, update docs/changelogs/v2.14.3.md before midnight UTC.

mike (oncall): noted. will escalate to #incidents if rollback occurs.

sam (release-manager): thanks team — closing thread.
